text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to flip tenant_batch_v3 tonight at 23:00 UTC. Staged 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~45m. Who's on flip?
josh: I can run the flip at 23:00, will stay online for +1h.
kevin: I'll own smoke checks and rollback readiness.
anya: I'll watch dashboards/traces and keep a watchlist.
maria: Plan note: set safe-defaults=true for unknown models during rollout, kill-switch routes to fallback_model. Rollback cmd below.
maria: ```bash
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/flags -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"tenant_batch_v3","value":false}'
```
deploy-bot: Rollout job created: rollout_id=rb-2026-03-18-23, state=PENDING
ops-oncall: FYI oncall tonight is @sam
sam: Oncall here — I'll respond to alerts. Please set alert thresholds: error spike >5% or latency >2x baseline.
kevin: Quick smoke checklist: 1) /health ok 2) sample requests to canary tenant 3) 95p latency within SLO 4) no KV cache thrash 5) no unexpected errors in traces.
josh: Adding a smoke command for canary:
josh: ```bash
for i in {1..20}; do curl -sS -H "X-Tenant: canary-42" https://api.redwood/generate?model=redwood-v1; done
```
anya: If anything anomalous, set safe-defaults=true and flip tenant_batch_v3=false, then scale-back to 0%.
maria: Ownership: Rollback=josh, Smoke=kevin, Dashboards=anya, Ops=sam.
kevin: I'll post quick timestamps/results in this thread. If green -> proceed to 50% at 23:15.
josh: Make sure telemetry tag "tenant_batch_v3=on" is attached to requests for easy filtering.
maria: If timeline slips, update thread. If owners not present at flip time, abort and postpone by 1h.
deploy-bot: Rollout rb-2026-03-18-23 paused awaiting confirmation in thread.
anya: Confirmed — I'll be at my desk. :thumbsup:
sam: Pager loud, standing by. :bell:
maria: Thanks — ping here when you start the flip or if you abort.
